# intervals.library: IsEmpty

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> True when the box is empty (inverted on either axis): no point lies inside.

## Signature

```plato
IsEmpty(self: Bounds2D): Boolean
IsEmpty(self: Bounds3D): Boolean
```

### Law_Bounds2DContainsCenter

// A non-empty box contains its own center point.
Law_Bounds2DContainsCenter(b: Bounds2D): Boolean
    => b.IsEmpty || b.Contains(b.Center);

    // True when the box is empty (inverted on either axis): no point lies inside.

    // True when the box is empty (inverted on any axis).
    IsEmpty(self: Bounds3D): Boolean
        => self.Min.X > self.Max.X || self.Min.Y > self.Max.Y || self.Min.Z > self.Max.Z;
